author_policy: author is null for every item except E5B. Producers commonly override the author with the system user name, so null means 'any value'.

annotations.notes: A summation with stacked limits: the upper limit, the operator and its main line, and the lower limit occupy three baselines, so no linearisation is canonical. Also exercises large-operator inclusion, since the glyph is far taller than the line band.

comparison: Compared exactly. There are no per-producer expectation files, no overrides and no variant lists: this file states what the document means, so a producer whose file cannot yield it is a finding to document, and a shortfall in our extractor is a bug to fix. Neither is an expectation to adjust.
extractor_options: Canonical values assume default options. --keep-hyphens changes E2A and --space-gap changes E3A; those are option axes, not producer differences.
failure_policy: A failing item is a tracked defect, in our extractor or in the producer. See PRODUCERS.md for observed producer behaviour. Nothing there relaxes this file.
order_policy: Items default to reading order and are compared exactly. An item marked order='undefined' has no canonical linearisation — stacked mathematical limits sit at three different baselines with no single correct sequence — so it is compared as a multiset of non-whitespace characters instead. That is a weaker assertion, but a precise one: nothing covered may be missing and nothing uncovered may appear. The boundaries of the selection are still fully asserted; only the sequence is not.
